title: Sunrise After Game Over
user_feedback: Even less sweet and melodic; noisier, shorter, without pretty keyboards
style: INSTRUMENTAL NOISE OUTRO, 35-55 seconds, end quickly. No singing, voice or humming. Almost non-musical: raw tape hiss, dusty static, low amplifier hum, worn electrical buzz, distant room noise, short granular crackles and intermittent dry mechanical clicks. An abandoned arcade powering down at dawn. Dark neutral, detached, rough and intimate, never sentimental, soothing or pretty. No keyboards, piano, electric piano, synth keys, bells, chimes, pads, chords, chord progression, arpeggios, lead melody, tune, guitar melody or bass melody. No pitched instrument phrases. No lush reverb, cinematic atmosphere, romantic harmony, crescendo or polished ambient soundtrack. Mostly noise and silence; irregular sparse pulses may drift but no beat or groove. A brief low noisy throb can disappear into hiss. Reduce density over the last seconds; abrupt power-off click and a short silence. Dusty lo-fi electronics, no sweetness.
